_comment: Concept ontology for Benchmark v0 (thermal / electrical / material physics domain). type follows a minimal upper ontology: Entity, Type, Quantity, Property, Constant. Class-to-class links use 'subtype_of' (e.g. Metal subtype_of Material); 'instance_of' is reserved for individual-to-class links (e.g. a specific copper sample instance_of Copper), which this concept ontology does not itself contain -- individuals only appear inside proposition statements (e.g. 'Copper_instance' in K004c).

concepts.name: Semiconductor
concepts.scope_note: Treated as a disjoint class from Metal for Benchmark-v0 tractability. Physically, metallic vs. semiconducting behavior is a transport regime that can depend on doping/pressure/phase, not an eternal property of a material identity -- a full K-IR ontology should model transport_regime(x, context) rather than class-level disjointness. Flagged, not fixed, in v0.

concepts.name: Body
concepts.description: generic physical object variable, e.g. x

concepts.name: Silicon
concepts.description: canonical semiconductor example, mirrors Copper's role for Metal

concepts.name: Speed
concepts.description: scalar: distance / time (contrast with Velocity, a vector)
